name: UR-01_Orchard_Watched_And_Decided_From_Afar
name_th: UR-01_สวนที่เฝ้าดูและตัดสินใจได้จากที่ไกล
flows: Change_Soil_And_Weather -> Watch_The_Orchard_From_Afar : Soil_And_Weather_Signs; Watch_The_Orchard_From_Afar -> Decide_Water_And_Fertiliser : Orchard_State_Seen
rationale: MISSION. MoE for question OA: in the durian orchards of Nonthaburi where the poles stand, 10 to 60 m from their gateways (GUIS slides 141-151), with the projects promising 400 m (GUIS slides 7-8), how well is the orchard known from afar, so that the farmer decides water and fertiliser without walking the rows: the orchard the farmer wants, the thesis's UN1? It needs from the system Readings_Delivered_At_400_m_Pct [96 .. 100] from SR-01_Deliver_Readings_From_400_m. Today: PARTLY_MET -- the readings arrive, but the farmers unplugged the gateway at times (GUIS slide 138; finding F-17).

rationale: MISSION. MoE for question OA: for a farm family reading the orchard by day and by night, how well can anyone read its state at a glance: the orchard the farmer wants, the thesis's UN2? It needs from the system Battery_Hours_Short_Of_A_Day_h [0 .. 0] from SR-04_Power_Itself_Day_And_Night, so that a station is still reading at night. Today: PARTLY_MET -- farmers could not use the web site at first and were taught it (GUIS slide 138), and a station runs 16 hours on its battery from full charge (P2 sec. 4.2).

rationale: MISSION. MoE for question OA: how well does the orchard warn of a harmful condition in time to act before the fruit suffers: the orchard the farmer wants, the thesis's UN3? It needs from the system Warning_Messages_Per_Month [0 .. 300] from SR-07_Warn_The_Farmer_In_Time. Today: NOT_MET -- the alarms went by LINE Notify, which ended on 31 March 2025 (finding F-09), and only the report every 4 hours still reaches the farmer (Thesis F-10).

It needs from the system Readings_Delivered_At_400_m_Pct [96 .. 100] from SR-01_Deliver_Readings_From_400_m, Battery_Hours_Short_Of_A_Day_h [0 .. 0] from SR-04_Power_Itself_Day_And_Night and Server_Uptime_Pct [100 .. 100] from SR-08_Record_Around_The_Clock_Securely.
